/adventurers/[luka]/story: A 16-year-old village kid who dreams of being a legendary hero. He's never swung a sword properly, yet he barged into the forge yelling, 'I'll dig up all the best materials!' Scared of everything, but his bragging? Legendary!
/adventurers/[garam]/trait/desc: +1 of a random material he brings back
/adventurers/[garam]/story: 21 years old and once the village's best porter. He can lift anything but barely says a word—unless he's hungry, then he just won't stop. He draws a longbow with those hauling arms and complains the arrows are too light.
/adventurers/[sera]/story: A mid-20s scout from who-knows-where. One wink and a shortcut appears—or so she says. Bow, blade, she does it all. Her motto: 'Pack light, brag heavy!'
/adventurers/[gregor]/story: A 40-something veteran who's rolled through 20+ years of battlefields. Says little, but every word hits hard. Hobby: polishing a battered old armor plate. Cracks dad jokes now and then—he's the only one laughing.
/adventurers/[torvin]/story: A dwarf warrior from a mining town. His braided beard jangles with iron rings, and his helmet lamp stays on even while he sleeps. Gruff as a boulder—until you mention ore. Then he'll talk till dawn.
/adventurers/[elarin]/story: An elf huntress from a faraway forest. Silvery-gold hair, a green cloak, and she can tell the weather just by the wind. She speaks slowly, but her bow is lightning fast.
